iterations.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production game sprite animation sheet for Frontier Command.
Reference image: the attached existing approved atlas. Reuse exactly its toy-3D seasonal-fantasy character identities and rich crisp rendering. Use ONLY: the Santa-like white-bearded red armored WARLORD carrying a square dark metal gold-trimmed warhammer (reference at row 4 column 5); the red-and-gold royal toy SOLDIER SWORDSMAN with tall red helmet, white moustache, short steel sword and round red shield with gold snowflake (reference row 3 column 5); the petite white-haired green hooded ELF ARCHER, red scarf, green tunic, brown boots and red/gold recurved bow (reference row 4 column 1). No new themes.
Create one true transparent RGBA animation atlas, portrait 1024 by 1536, exactly FOUR columns and SIX rows, with 24 distinct frames, equal square 256 by 256 cells. All cells have generous transparent padding and no border. Every entire character and weapon stays strictly within its own cell.
Row 1: Warlord WALK, 4 frames left to right: left-leg forward contact with opposite arm balance; left passing under pelvis with heel lifted; right-leg forward contact with opposite arm balance; right passing under pelvis. His hammer is carried low. REAL alternating leg and arm poses, same character, not duplicates.
Row 2: same Warlord ATTACK, 4 frames: ready planted feet and hammer beside shoulder; strong windup with hammer raised above shoulder, torso twists back; forceful downward-diagonal hammer strike forwards to screen-right with torso leaning forward; recovery pulling hammer back to shoulder. NO magical effects or impact bursts.
Row 3: Swordsman WALK with the same four alternating contact/passing leg poses. Same sword and same shield every frame. Shield carried in the same hand.
Row 4: same Swordsman ATTACK: guard; pronounced sword-arm backswing with sword raised; strong forward sword slash/thrust to screen-right, knees bent and shield tucked in; recoil to guard. Keep sword in the same hand and shield in the same hand through all frames.
Row 5: Archer WALK with the same four alternating contact/passing leg poses, carrying the same bow lowered in one hand. Same quiver and clothing every frame.
Row 6: same Archer ATTACK: ready, lifting bow; full draw with one arrow on string and drawing elbow pulled back; release with bow arm still extended and empty string, drawing hand beside cheek; recovery lowering bow. NO detached flying arrows.
Camera: all 24 frames are the SAME fixed elevated three-quarter southeast view, face and front visible, facing screen-right, never changing camera or direction. Bodies stay on the spot, not travelling across their cells. Animated body parts move, the root position stays fixed.
CRITICAL registration: in every 256px cell the ground-root midpoint between planted boot soles is exactly x=128, y=226. Head/body scale is fixed within each character's eight frames; do NOT shrink a body when a weapon is raised. Aim for Warlord body ~164px from hat to feet; Swordsman helmet-to-feet ~172px; Archer hood-to-feet ~164px. Raised weapons use overhead padding, not a smaller body. Leave room above and to both sides for attacks. Keep physical proportions, face, beard/hair, helmet/hood, armor, colors, weapon and shield design invariant across every frame of an actor.
Style: high quality polished chunky toy-like 3D renders, sharp readable silhouette, soft handpainted material shading, saturated holiday red/green/gold with white fur trim matching the reference. Soft consistent upper-left light. No cast shadow outside character.
Background: genuinely transparent, no checkerboard drawn into pixels, no gradient, no scenery.
Absolutely no text, labels, numbers, grid lines, tile backgrounds, drop shadows, team rings, ground discs, decorative objects, motion trails, sparkles, gore, or detached projectiles. Exactly 24 full characters and nothing else.
iterations.note: Initial 24-frame sheet; some cell boundary overlaps and weak gait.

iterations.prompt:
Edit target: Image 1, the 24-character animation sheet. Supporting identity reference: Image 2, approved original atlas.
Use case: identity-preserve. Produce a corrected PRODUCTION sprite atlas with actual transparent RGBA background. Exactly 4 columns by 6 rows and no other content, 1024x1536.
Make two critical corrections:
1. SPACE THE FRAMES. Every frame must fit in its own 256x256 cell with at least 25 pixels transparent gutter to ALL neighboring cells. Scale the figures DOWN uniformly to 70% of their current size. Do NOT change the scale between frames of one actor. Each character's boot-ground root sits at the middle of its cell, 200 pixels from the cell top. The biggest raised weapon still needs at least 25 pixels overhead margin. Nothing may touch, overlap, or cross a cell border. Entire bodies and weapons visible.
2. REAL ALTERNATING GAIT. Change only the walking pose in rows 1, 3 and 5 to four clearly different in-place walking phases. Frame1: LEFT leg stretched forward, RIGHT leg visibly extended backward. Frame2: LEFT planted, RIGHT knee raised forward. Frame3: RIGHT leg stretched forward, LEFT leg visibly extended backward. Frame4: RIGHT planted, LEFT knee raised forward. These must look visibly different in adjacent frames, especially switched leading leg between frames1 and3. Arms and carried weapon counter-swing with walking. Keep same weapon hand and shield hand, costume, hair, face and camera. No duplicates of one leg-forward pose.
Keep the good ATTACK sequences in rows2,4,6 from Image1, only space/scale them for correct gutters:
Row2 Warlord attack: shoulder-ready, hammer raised winding up, low forward hammer strike, recovery.
Row4 Swordsman attack: guard, high backswing, forward thrust/slash, recovery.
Row6 Archer attack: ready, full drawn bow with arrow, empty-bow-string release, lower bow recovery.
Keep ALL characters in fixed elevated three-quarter southeast view facing screen-right, no camera changes. Preserve every identity, face, outfit and equipment from Image1 and approved Image2: stout Santa white-bearded red/gold Warlord with square warhammer; tall-red-helmet royal white-moustached Swordsman with steel sword and red/gold round shield; white-haired green-hooded elf Archer with red scarf and red/gold recurved bow. Match polished chunky toy-3D material rendering.
No effects or moving projectiles. No scenery, visible background, shadow, team ring, grid lines, borders, labels, text, numbers, sparks, blood, or extraneous elements. A true transparent game sprite sheet. Keep exactly 24 characters in the stated 4x6 arrangement.
iterations.note: Spacing and gait correction; spacing still too tight.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit only the layout of this sprite sheet; preserve the exact same 24 character images, faces, outfit designs, handedness and existing poses. DO NOT enlarge them to fill their cells.
The sheet is 1024 by 1536 pixels, with 4 columns and 6 rows. There are currently 24 large figures almost touching. Make each of these 24 figures visibly much SMALLER, about HALF ITS CURRENT SIZE, and recenter it within its original tile. Every complete figure INCLUDING raised sword, hammer or bow must be at most 136 pixels tall and at most 150 pixels wide in its 256px-square tile. Most of the canvas must be clear transparent negative space. This is an evenly spaced sheet of SMALL THUMBNAIL SPRITES.
Top-left cell: character between x=55 and x=201 and y=60 and y=200. The other 23 cells repeat this spacing with 256px offsets. Every character’s two feet midpoint is horizontally centered. All feet ground at y=200 within their cell. All 24 tiles have HUGE blank transparent gutters on all sides. No figure touches or crosses a tile edge, even raised weapons.
Maintain FIXED BODY SCALE across the eight frames of each actor: Warlord head-to-feet body ~108px, Swordsman plume-to-feet ~120px, Archer hood-to-feet ~112px. Raised weapons may reach slightly above the head but do not shrink the torso. The Warlord walk and attack bodies should be same size. The Swordsman walk and attack bodies should be same size. The Archer walk and attack bodies should be same size.
Keep row order exactly: Warlord walk, Warlord attack, Swordsman walk, Swordsman attack, Archer walk, Archer attack. Four poses per row, same poses and order as the provided image. All face right, same camera.
Background must be true transparent RGBA. No background or shadows at all. No text, numbers, lines, checkerboard pattern, tile edges, grids, effects or new details. Crisp toy-3D sprites matching input.
iterations.note: Selected final immutable PNG; separated silhouettes, attack poses retained.
